integrity: The ellipsoid formulas follow from symmetry-derived optimality, exact two-endpoint containment and strictly concave scalar optimization; the finite contact measures certify unrestricted optimization. All computations are reproducible with the included script and stated standard scientific Python dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Only centrally aligned, orthogonal Euclidean block cylinders with \(p,q\ge1\), \(p+q\ge3\), and \(a\ge b>0\). The equality case a=b and unattained b/a->0 bound are distinguished. The three-dimensional two-scalar-cylinder problem is excluded. Full historical priority not independently certified; numerical verification supplements an analytical proof.
title: Exact John–Löwner ellipsoids of higher-dimensional orthogonal block bicylinders
